features.name: Knoll
features.teach: A knoll is a rounded hilltop: ground falls away in every direction. On the map it is a small closed contour ring.

features.name: Ridgeline
features.teach: A ridgeline is a line of high ground. Ground falls away on both sides but stays level or rises along it. Contours form long U or V shapes pointing away from high ground.

features.name: Saddle
features.teach: A saddle is the dip on a ridge between two high points. Ground rises in two directions (to each knoll) and falls in the other two. Contours look like an hourglass.

features.name: Valley
features.teach: A valley is low ground between two spurs or ridges, usually with a watercourse. Contours form U or V shapes pointing uphill, towards higher ground.

features.name: Knoll (the eastern one)
features.teach: This is the other knoll on the map. Check which closed contour ring your flag is marked on.
